speaker: Doctor
text:
Let me start by assessing your symptoms. Have you noticed any specific changes in your bowel habits, such as diarrhea or constipation, or any blood in your stool? Also, have you had any recent fevers or night sweats that you might not have mentioned?

Please note: This is a fictional scenario for the purpose of this exercise. If you are experiencing these symptoms in real life, please consult a healthcare professional immediately.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those "drenching night sweats" are significant; have they occurred at night specifically, and have you noticed any swollen lymph nodes, particularly in the neck or armpits? I also need to know if you have had any unexplained fevers. REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, CRP, LDH, and Liver Function Tests.
